import Mathlib.RingTheory.AdicCompletion.AsTensorProduct

/-! The actual original Taylor embedding is faithfully flat, before its genuine analytic syzygy consumer. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Set Classical
namespace TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.HironakaActualTaylorFaithfullyFlat
noncomputable section
open FirstPass HolGerm HironakaActualOriginalFormalTaylor
  HironakaActualFormalIdealContraction HironakaActualOriginalAdicCompletion

/-- Flatness is internally obtained from the ACTUAL original completion and its Taylor identity. -/
theorem originalTaylorAlgHom_flat (n : ℕ) : (originalTaylorAlgHom n).toRingHom.Flat := by
  let R := HolGerm (ComplexModel (0+n))
  let m := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R
  let := isNoetherianRing_holGerm_euclidean (0+n)
  have hflat : (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion m R)).Flat :=
    RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr inferInstance
  have he : (actualOriginalCompletionEquiv n).toRingHom.comp
      (algebraMap R (AdicCompletion m R))=(originalTaylorAlgHom n).toRingHom := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro g
    exact actualOriginalCompletionEquiv_of n g
  rw [← he]
  exact hflat.comp (RingHom.Flat.of_bijective (actualOriginalCompletionEquiv n).bijective)

/-- True whole original ideal contraction upgrades the actual flat Taylor map to faithful flatness. -/
theorem originalTaylorAlgHom_faithfullyFlat (n : ℕ) :
    (originalTaylorAlgHom n).toRingHom.FaithfullyFlat := by
  let R := HolGerm (ComplexModel (0+n))
  let S := MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ
  let : Algebra R S := (originalTaylorAlgHom n).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  have : Module.Flat R S := originalTaylorAlgHom_flat n
  change Module.FaithfullyFlat R S
  apply (Module.FaithfullyFlat.iff_flat_and_proper_ideal R S).mpr
  refine ⟨inferInstance,?_⟩
  intro I hI htop
  have hmap : Ideal.map (originalTaylorAlgHom n).toRingHom I=⊤ := by
    apply (Submodule.restrictScalars_eq_top_iff R S S).mp
    simpa only [Ideal.smul_top_eq_map,RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using htop
  have hc := comap_map_originalTaylorAlgHom n I
  rw [hmap,Ideal.comap_top] at hc
  exact hI hc.symm

import TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.HironakaActualTaylorFaithfullyFlat

/-! Whole original ideal intersections under the genuine Taylor embedding. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Set Classical
namespace TranscendentalNakamaye.Pending.HironakaActualFormalIdealIntersections
noncomputable section
open FirstPass HolGerm HironakaActualOriginalFormalTaylor HironakaActualTaylorFaithfullyFlat

private theorem actual_extension_finite_expression (n : ℕ)
    (I : Ideal (HolGerm (ComplexModel (0+n)))) (F : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ)
    (hF : F ∈ Ideal.map (originalTaylorAlgHom n).toRingHom I) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (G : Fin r → HolGerm (ComplexModel (0+n)))
      (A : Fin r → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ℂ),
      (∀ i,G i ∈ I) ∧ F=∑ i,originalTaylorAlgHom n (G i)*A i := by
  let := isNoetherianRing_holGerm_euclidean (0+n)
  obtain ⟨r,G,hG⟩ := Submodule.fg_iff_exists_fin_generating_family.mp (IsNoetherian.noetherian I)
  have hspan : Ideal.span (range G)=I := hG
  have hmap : Ideal.map (originalTaylorAlgHom n).toRingHom I=
      Ideal.span (range fun i => originalTaylorAlgHom n (G i)) := by
    rw [← hspan,Ideal.map_span,← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  rw [hmap] at hF
  obtain ⟨A,hA⟩ := Ideal.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun.mp hF
  refine ⟨r,G,A,?_,?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [← hspan]
    exact Ideal.mem_span_range_self (x := i)
  · simpa only [mul_comm] using hA.symm
